text:
[NDBG.14.2.1] Loads a recorded fact stream ([RFCS.1]) mid-session,
entering replay. The adapter must refuse a trace that was not recorded with
the session's program ([NDBG.14r.6.5]).

Request:
```json
{ "path": "/path/to/session.trace" }
```

Response:
```json
{
  "duration_ns": 45000000000,
  "event_count": 8432,
  "rule_count": 12,
  "schema_count": 7
}
```
